Flying Friends. MeMo and BaBa enjoy playing with a paper plane and a glider before helping their friends, the Yummies, do something they've never done before - fly high up in...
Makka Pakka's Piles of Three. Children's programme. The Tombliboos are indoors playing with their bricks while Makka Pakka is making piles of stones, but he's missing a stone.
Mo Gilligan. Oh No, George. Mo Gilligan reads a hilarious story about George, a dog who is always tempted to do the wrong thing.
This Is CBeebies. Programmes start at 6.00am.
Watermelon. It's time for a picnic. The Nogglins discover something crunchy, and Fidd slips and slides into trouble.
Banana. Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Banana revealing yet another astonishing secret about herself in the opera piece, I've Got a Secret.
Talkie Taxi. Children's animation. Bing and Sula discover a new toy at Amma's creche - a talking ride-on car. It seems like fun until talkie taxi keeps saying the same thing.
Big Dance. Preschool series. The children in Tummy Tales and the Teletubbies both spend some time dancing.
Carpet. Tee accidently marks Mo's newly cleaned carpet. Uh-oh.
Many Mixes Make Brown. Brown takes the Colourblocks exploring in the forest. Learn different ways to mix brown with the Colourblocks.
Butlers. Jerry Lee, the chief scientist in the dream house is onboarding a new butler.
Bus Ride. The seaside bus breaks down, but Bing still finds a way to have fun.
Dewey Dragon. Preston is in costume as everyone's favourite character, Dewey Dragon, but he isn't ready for how demanding Dewey's fans are. Mojo and Bo need to help him escape...
The Dos and Don'ts Badge. The Squirrels are causing a bit too much mess in the clubhouse, so Duggee explains that they need to think more carefully about what they are doing.
The Nature Badge. The Squirrels are excited to learn more about the natural world.
Sheepdog. Dad agrees to play sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum.
Grandad. When Bluey and Bingo visit Grandad, he takes them on an adventure into the bush.
Bannau Brycheiniog, Wales. In Wales, Kym learns to read the signs and finds a starry surprise.
The Tale of the Flying Rabbits. Animated series. When Peter learns that his father once crash-landed a flying machine into Mr McGregor's garden, he vows to find it and pilot it...
Weaver Bird. Tweak and Bud find themselves stranded on a floating island made of papyrus reeds.
Double Duets. It's time for karaoke in Numberland. A nervous One discovers that doubling up is a great way to have a friend by your side - and it makes singing twice as fun.
The Mixed-Up Picture Machine. Magenta's mixed-up picture maker accidentally makes funny images.
Camping Buddy Day. Love Monster goes camping with Delivery Duckling, but things keep going wrong for him.
Unicorn. Bella and Lift visit Tincy and Brock in the Sing Song Forest, where a unicorn inspires a Tincy Twist and lights up the forest with song.
Hey Duggee: Top of the Pups
The Numbers Song. Come and join the number jam - it's counting with Duggee.
Puppet Show. Bing and Sula are doing a puppet show for Flop, Amma and Pando, and Coco wants to join in. But Bing's loud Biteysaurus isn't welcome, as he is hurting Sula's ears.
Teddy. Dee encourages a friend to say 'teddy', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see a rainbow teddy, a flying teddy, a fluffy teddy and even a flower teddy.
Sea Shells. Tralala brings a periwinkle home and introduces her to an exciting new taste.
Mae, Bee and the Bearded Bake. Mae, Bee and friends eat some magical buns of ageing that turn them 500 years old.
Afraid. Lou sings a song to conquer his fear but wakes a sleeping dinosaur.
More about Up and Down. Stop-motion preschool programme. The Twirlywoos visit a garden with a deflated inflatable. The lady brings out a pump and starts pumping up and down.
Vets. Educational series using Makaton sign language. Today, Justin takes his friend's pet dog to see a vet. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble pretends to be a vet for his toy patients.
Flamenco. Preschool series. The Teletubbies are flamenco dancing! Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po are surprisingly good.
Dolly. Giovanna and Baby Bear invite babies and their grown-ups to explore dollies through discovery, play, song and story. Babies and grown-ups at home can join in too.
Birthday Party. Elsee plays I-spy during a birthday party with her friends Ethan and Oscar.
The Treasure Indoors. Maddie and Triggs discover that the tiniest of indoor sounds can make the biggest noises.
Dance Competition. In between practising their competition dance moves, Rebecca and Murphi create a bottle penguin and a pineapple puppet.
Raa Raa and Boomy Thunder. Animation set in the Jingly Jangly Jungle. There's a storm in the jungle but no-one is sure what the loud thumps coming from the sky are.
Shaun. Dad transforms his hand into their old friend Shaun, a chaotic, undisciplined Emu.
The Senses Badge. Roly has lost his best potato, but Duggee finds it using his sense of smell.
Chantelle and Rory's Teeny Tiny Creatures
Blue Tits. Chantelle visits a school that has a bird box which is currently home to a family of blue tits, whilst Rory meet a young birdwatcher in her garden.
George and Freddie's Woodland Adventure. George and Freddie go on an intrepid woodland adventure. Look out for the troll.
Straw-berry the Scarecrow. Small is trying to grow a sunflower to enter it into the tallest sunflower competition.
Mission. Bandage Team. Therapy dog Sylvie and her owner, Katrina, visit the doctor's to help a little boy called Ben feel brave enough to see Dr Stevens about his grazed knee.
European Bison and Red-Billed Hornbill. Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet bison and red-billed hornbills.
Firefighter Karen shows us her fabulous helmet. We see how important it is for Karen to wear it while she does her heroic job, as well as the amazing things it does.
Top Dog Waffle. The after schoolers want Waffle to win the Top Dog competition. But when Pepper needs help, Waffle is happy to step in and assist his sausage dog friend.
Rock Music. Oona is nervous about her first dawn chorus and practises singing with Mama.
Snowbells. It's been snowing in the garden, and Yukee helps Sonny find uses for a large collection of recycled bells.
The Long Goodbye. Lu finds it hard to say goodbye to her favourite uncle.
Fine Forest Happy Helpers. The Piggies try to teach Wilf how to help others.
Now We Are Six to Ten. Children's animation. Are you sitting comfortably? Then we'll begin a story all about Numberblocks Six to Ten. Learn all about the numbers 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10.
Quick. The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. Q sings I Need U, but she can't do it on her own. Unwilling U lends a hand.
Keep it Colourful. Maddie has a colourful day out with her friends, playing games and painting. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble gets messy decorating a cake.
Rain. Preschool series. A cloud appears in Teletubbyland and it begins to rain. The Teletubbies watch the flowers bloom. Another cloud appears and it rains pink tubby custard.
City Parks. Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how city parks play such an important role in the environment.
Hair Clippers and Ballet Shoes. Maddie visits a barber to find out how hair clippers work and goes to a factory to see how ballet shoes are made.
Road Making Machines. Grace shows off three incredible machines that all help make roads.
End of Term. It's the end of term. Otto and his friends wrap up warm and head outside to look for signs of winter in the forest area. Inside, Jud, Leo and Leon cut out paper...
Humphead Parrotfish. Animated deep sea adventures with Captain Barnacles and his explorers. The Octonauts use magnets to try to stop a meteor that is heading towards the Octopod.
The Tale of the Lying Fox. Animated series. When Mr Tod is trapped in Mr McGregor's garden, Peter reluctantly agrees to help him escape.
The Breakfast Badge. Tag is feeling grumpy because he didn't eat his breakfast. Luckily, Duggee has his Breakfast Badge, and soon the Squirrels will too.
Operation Seal. The Piris believe a seal colony is planning a takeover, but are their fears justified.
Broccoli Alone. Supertato is out chasing a milkshake robot and leaves Broccoli in charge of Tato Tower. Evil Pea tries to take over the tower, but Broccoli puts on a great defence.
Mission Family Photo. The ducklings want to take a beautiful family portrait with their pop, but Weasy can't help making faces and monkeying around.
Ice Cream Float. Betty's ice cream is lifting everyone off the ground. Mojo and Bo need to get them down.
Sheepdog. Dad agrees to play sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum.
Grandad. When Bluey and Bingo visit Grandad, he takes them on an adventure into the bush.
A Lion's Pride. Winton has terrible toothache but isn't ready to lose his fang. Zog and the doctors must help him feel proud again of the way he looks.
Berry Bandit. PC Plum needs to identify a pesky bird that has been munching his prize strawberries.
Waffle's Ball Pit Pond. Preschool comedy drama series. Ali and Anaya come to play, but Waffle isn't joining in. He's next door with Mrs Hobbs, who is teaching him to be a good dog.
The Dancing Wish. Rafi and Dash want Jake to dance, but he's too busy working. When Rafi makes a wish, Jake can't stop air guitaring, tangoing and break dancing across the...
It's Time to Make Music. JoJo discovers that Gran Gran used to be in a band with Grandad.
Fancy Park. When their local park is closed, Sarah and Duck try to find a suitable alternative.
The Space Tortoise. Animation about a family of small creatures who live on, and inside, a planet. A space tortoise is woken up by a mysterious tune Tiny heard coming from the sky.
Seeds. MeMo and BaBa discover a dandelion clock and have fun blowing the seeds. The Yummies help them plant the seeds, and they marvel at how a seed can become a beautiful flower.
Running About. Children's programme. Everybody runs about in the garden so much that Makka Pakka can't wash faces. After a lot of chasing, Makka Pakka finally gets to wash...
Rose Ayling-Ellis. Can Bears Ski? Rose Ayling-Ellis signs a Bedtime Story about Little Bear, who is deaf and struggling to understand the world around him.
